dedupe_keys.name: gb transmission network data cardiff university

description: This data set represents the electricity transmission network of Great Britain for power system analysis, network planning and renewable integration studies. It was published by Morteza Shafiekhani at Cardiff University and is referenced by an article in Applied Energy. A spreadsheet has one sheet per device type with a row per device: terminals with voltage and coordinates; transmission lines with end terminals, length, positive and zero sequence resistance, reactance, susceptance and capacitance, rated voltage and current; transformers with ratings, tap position and impedances; static and synchronous generators with plant category and power limits; demand at each node for the peak of winter 2024; shunt devices; and static VAR compensators. Coverage is the GB transmission system at node and device level. The data are downloadable from Cardiff University's research data repository (2025) under CC-BY-4.0 at no cost. Caveats: the provider says the model was built from validated models and public data, so parameters may differ from operator data, and demand is a single winter peak. Simulation uses are power flow, reliability and congestion studies of the GB grid. Related records: none linked on the provider's pages read on the day.
